exposure: Autism-Spectrum Quotient (AQ) subscales (social skills, attention switching, attention to detail, communication, and imagination)
outcome: Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS) subscales (anxiety and depression)
Mother-to-Infant Bonding Scale (MIBS) subscales (lack of affection and anger and rejection)
cohort: The study included 2692 women who completed questionnaires at 1 month postpartum.
finding: Maternal autistic traits were found to be related to anxiety and depression to a certain degree, but only slightly related to maternal-infant bonding at 1 month postpartum.
